guard_guest() {
  local token vendor virt inside outside length extra
  local -a uid_rows
  [[ -r /etc/bashos-parity-vm && -r /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || return 125
  IFS= read -r token </etc/bashos-parity-vm || return 125
  IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || return 125
  [[ $vendor == QEMU && $token =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || return 125
  (( UID == EUID )) || return 125
  if (( EUID == 0 )); then
    mapfile -t uid_rows </proc/self/uid_map || return 125
    (( ${#uid_rows[@]} == 1 )) || return 125
    read -r inside outside length extra <<<"${uid_rows[0]}" || return 125
    [[ $inside == 0 && $outside == 2000 && $length == 1 && -z $extra ]] || return 125
  else
    (( EUID == 2000 )) || return 125
  fi
  virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || return 125
  [[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || return 125
}
guard_guest || { printf 'refusing non-fixture guest\n' >&2; exit 125; }

cases.purpose: With distinct installed credentials bind-mounted over /etc/shadow and /etc/passwd, userdb verify using the private fixture environment accepts only the fixture password and rejects the installed one, while the same call with no fixture environment reads the installed files (control).
cases.oracle: Independent argon2 CLI hashes for two different passwords for the same account name; a mapped-user mount namespace makes the installed files distinguishable, so any consultation of the installed files changes the verdict.
cases.comparison: Exact expectation for status and output derived independently of the candidate; raw stdout, stderr and fixture files are retained as diagnostics.

files.inner.sh:
[[ $(type -t userdb) == builtin ]] || exit 99
/usr/bin/mount --bind "$PWD/inst/shadow" /etc/shadow || exit 90
/usr/bin/mount --bind "$PWD/inst/passwd" /etc/passwd || exit 90
export BASHUSERDB_CONF=$PWD/empty.conf BPW_LOCK_DIR=$PWD/lock BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0
mkdir -p lock
v() { "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?; }
echo "control-default-paths-use-installed: installed-pw=$(unset BASHUSERDB_PASSWD PHCLIB_PASSWD PHCLIB_SHADOW; v userdb verify fixtureuser installed-password) fixture-pw=$(unset BASHUSERDB_PASSWD PHCLIB_PASSWD PHCLIB_SHADOW; v userdb verify fixtureuser fixture-password)"
export BASHUSERDB_PASSWD=$PWD/fix/passwd PHCLIB_PASSWD=$PWD/fix/passwd PHCLIB_SHADOW=$PWD/fix/shadow
echo "fixture-paths: fixture-pw=$(v userdb verify fixtureuser fixture-password) installed-pw=$(v userdb verify fixtureuser installed-password)"
before=$(< fix/shadow); echo "fixture-shadow-unchanged=$([[ $(< fix/shadow) == "$before" ]] && echo yes || echo no) installed-shadow-unchanged=$(/usr/bin/cmp -s inst/shadow /etc/shadow && echo yes || echo no)"
